canonical_equations: min sum(w*(y-sum_k(a_k*T_k))^2), a_k>=0; exhaustive ordered active-subset Cholesky solves with RN32 residual ranking and explicit pivot gate.
input_contract: encoding=binary32-hex; templates[M,N]>=0,M3..5,N M..128; flux,weights[R,N],R1..64,weights>=0; R*2^M*(N*M+M^3)<=2097152; finite RN32 intermediates.
output_contract: R x [u32 status,positive_coefficient_mask,f32 chi2,coefficients[M]]; status1 zero information,2 any principal Cholesky pivot<=RN(maxdiag*2^-18); remaining fields0 on failure; no covariance or arbitrary-group guarantee.
result_contract: R x [u32 status,positive_coefficient_mask,f32 chi2,coefficients[M]]; status1 zero information,2 any principal Cholesky pivot<=RN(maxdiag*2^-18); remaining fields0 on failure; no covariance or arbitrary-group guarantee.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
